verses.text: From the elder, to my dear friend Gaius, whom I truly love.
Dear friend, I pray that everything goes well for you and that you are healthy, just as your soul is doing well.
I was very glad when some brothers came and told me about your faithfulness to the truth, and how you live in the truth.
Nothing gives me greater joy than to hear that my children are living in the truth.
Dear friend, you are being faithful in what you do for the brothers, even though they are strangers to you.
They have told the church about your love. Please help them on their journey in a way that honours God.
They went out for the sake of the Name of Jesus, and they took nothing from people who do not believe.
So we should welcome people like them, so that we work together for the truth.
I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the most important among them, does not accept what we say.

So if I come, I will point out what he is doing. He says evil and untrue things about us. And that is not enough for him. He also refuses to welcome the brothers, and he stops those who want to welcome them, and throws them out of the church.
Dear friend, do not copy what is evil, but copy what is good. Anyone who does good is from God. Anyone who does evil has not seen God.
Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that what we say is true.
I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to use pen and ink.
I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face. Peace be with you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet each of the friends there by name.
